analysis:
Examined both documentation changes, configuration metadata and supplied surrounding text against the canonical definition index and detailed T-041 evidence. docs/provider/two-mac-cluster.md:536–583 replaces manual pair updates with default-on coordinated staging, drain, restart, re-planning and rollback; docs/reference/configuration.md:410 extends DARKBLOOM_NO_UPDATE_CHECK to ClusterServiceCommand.supervisorConfiguration. These documents establish intended behavior, not enforcement. No concrete security regression is independently supported by this documentation-only evidence.
Integration must verify release authenticity before staging/install, agreement on the exact release across peers, drain admission closure and timeout recovery, and authorization/qualification renewal after restart or predecessor rollback (A-011, A-016, A-017, T-053, T-054). Validate the new cluster crash/quarantine authority against T-043 and confirm the opt-out reaches both services, including manually requested updates. Relevant implementation entry points are provider-swift/Sources/darkbloom/ClusterServiceCommand.swift and the coordinated updater/restart implementation, absent here.
Surrounding cache claims at two-mac-cluster.md:464–504 and 632–640 describe encrypted, scoped reuse and synced cache policy; these lines are unchanged, so they do not establish a new T-041 regression. Likewise, the unchanged FileVault/automatic-login advice and privileged link-fix script are not new findings. No changes to request encryption, credentials, attestation evidence or billing are visible. Implementation review remains necessary to validate the material new update lifecycle; missing implementation is a coverage limit, not proof of absent controls.
